Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 20

“Having given up attachment to the fruits of action, ever content and dependent on nothing, such a one does nothing at all even while fully engaged in action.”

A precise description of the paradox from the inside. Nothing about the activity changes; what disappears is the dependence that made it feel like it belonged to someone.
